text: I don't want no fine words and I don't want no more lies! I want to know what you KNOW!” “See here, Mr. Valborg, you may stop this bullying right now. I'm not one of your farmwomen. I don't know where your son is, and there's no reason why I should know.” Her defiance ran out in face of his immense flaxen stolidity. He raised his fist, worked up his anger with the gesture, and sneered: “You dirty city women wit' your fine ways and fine dresses!
